## Verification

## Review / promotion gate

- [ ] Final diff reviewed in a separate pass; reviewed SHA and findings recorded.
- [ ] Appropriate checks passed, or limitations meet the intended milestone gate.
- [ ] For testing: usable entry point, candidate note/index, previous testing comparison and explicit model approval of the exact SHA.
- [ ] For main: full MVP ready for the first implementation release; user tested and explicitly approved the exact testing tag/SHA; approval reference attached.
- [ ] After testing publication: remote SHA/tag verified and user update delivered.

Mark inapplicable promotion items N/A with a reason. Do not check a box for an action that has not occurred. Follow [the repository development contract](https://github.com/buttery-x3/flamehorn-desktop/blob/development/docs/repo-development-contract.md).
